title: Registration of money services businesses
definition: The requirement that a person who conducts a money services business — such as dealing in foreign currency, issuing or redeeming stored-value instruments, or transmitting money — register with the financial crimes authority, and that a registered business maintain an anti-money-laundering programme of its own. A fintech or payments business may be a money services business without calling itself one, and the classification drives which obligations apply.
evidence_to_cite: the registration record, and the registration identifier
the activities the business conducts, and the classification applied to each
the anti-money-laundering programme, where the business is a registrant

sources.citation: Money services business registration and programme requirements (31 CFR 1020.380 and 1020.220), summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
